searchText: Are people allowed to edit two EIPs in one PR? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5299 Label is `updateEIP` when it should be `newEIPFile`. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5313 Raised an issue with EIP-Bot Mixing a new EIP and an existing EIP is confusing. I assume this was done in error as they don't share authors, so you shouldn't do this.
